name: Mega Spark
doc: Mega Spark (Tri-Point's enemy attack): the master and its tasks - the caster moves toward the targets leaning forward, rings at three anchor points of its skeleton, electric arcs over its body to them, then the orb layout and arcs from the anchors to it, lightning bolts from the orb to the targets in turn (ribbons of points drifting and branching), strike and hit layouts and sparks where they end, the screen fades, the sound; the damage, the caster back in place. Its tasks are the port's code (FFNx mag279_mega_spark.cpp) run on the program's memory (its pools, bolt points and packet arenas in the magic buffer).

copy.doc: Where this effect's copy is in FF8_EN.exe: the program stands in for these functions.

module.doc: The port module whose code runs: its memory [from, + size) - in a copy, a block of its own.

exe_data.doc: The exe data the effect uses (@key in its values).

director.doc: The port's file loader, setup and root (they start its tasks)

parts.title: Director
parts.doc: The main task's timeline: the caster moves toward the targets leaning forward and back at the end, the sound, the screen fades, the damage (every target of action 0), the end

parts.title: Rings
parts.doc: A ring layout at each of the caster's three anchor points, leaning with it

parts.title: Orb
parts.doc: The orb layout at the caster's orb point

parts.title: Arcs
parts.doc: Electric arcs (screen-space ribbons, jittered): over the caster's body from triangles of its skeleton to the anchor points, then from the anchor points to the orb point; each fades out after a while

parts.title: Bolts
parts.doc: Lightning bolts from the orb point to the targets in turn: a ribbon of points drifting and jumping at random, growing branches, its points fading

parts.title: Strikes and hits
parts.doc: A strike layout where a striking bolt ends, a hit layout where a branch ends at or below the ground

parts.title: Sparks
parts.doc: A spark where a branch ends above the ground
